response: Half-dose contrast-enhanced three-dimensional MR angiography is sufficient for the abdominal aorta and pelvis. According to the retrieved matches, using a diluted contrast medium injected at a rate of 1 mL/second, half-dose MR angiography depicted the abdominal aorta and its branches as clearly as using a full single dose. This suggests that a half-dose may be adequate for imaging the abdominal aorta and pelvis, potentially reducing the amount of contrast agent needed while maintaining image quality.
